question: how many demo activities are there in total?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo'

question: find deals still in the negotiation stage worth more than 200,000
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'negotiation' AND d.value > 200000

question: Show customers in the SMB segment with prospect status who joined this year.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'SMB' AND c.status = 'prospect' AND c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today())

question: meeting activities with negative sentiment lasting more than 60 minutes
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'meeting' AND a.sentiment = 'negative' AND a.duration_minutes > 60

question: Find resolved tickets with a resolution time of more than 48 hours
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved' AND t.resolution_time_hours > 48

question: list the Account-Management sales reps in the EMEA region please
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.team = 'Account-Management' AND r.region = 'EMEA'

question: Show won deals closed last month worth between 100,000 and 300,000.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.value BETWEEN 100000 AND 300000 AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today())

question: find active customers who signed up in the last 90 days, excluding the SMB segment
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.segment != 'SMB' AND c.created_at >= subtractDays(now(), 90)

question: Call or email activities in the last 2 weeks with negative sentiment, please show them.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type IN ('call','email') AND a.sentiment = 'negative' AND a.timestamp >= subtractWeeks(now(), 2)

question: how many customers per segment?
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment

question: total activity duration per type
sql: SELECT a.type, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type

question: revenue per sales rep
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name

question: Summary of the number of new deals per month throughout last year, sorted from the earliest month.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.created_date) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.created_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan ASC

question: which customers have more than 5 tickets?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING count() > 5

question: median activity duration for each type
sql: SELECT a.type, quantile(0.5)(a.duration_minutes) AS median_durasi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type

question: How many distinct customers have a deal in each stage?
sql: SELECT d.stage, uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.stage

question: total revenue per customer region
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY wilayah

question: average ticket resolution time per priority, only resolved or closed ones
sql: SELECT t.priority, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('resolved','closed') GROUP BY t.priority

question: Which sales teams have total revenue above 5 million?
sql: SELECT r.team, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team HAVING sum(d.value) > 5000000

question: top 5 companies by revenue
sql: SELECT c.company, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.company ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 5

question: Calculate the revenue and number of won deals for each product.
sql: SELECT product, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY product

question: which sales reps have had activities with more than 300 different customers?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, uniqExact(a.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING uniqExact(a.customer_id) > 300

question: For each customer segment, show the number of won deals and their average value, only for segments with more than 100 won deals.
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_won, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment HAVING count() > 100

question: number of urgent tickets per week over the last 3 months
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.created_at >= subtractMonths(now(), 3) GROUP BY minggu

question: how many positive vs negative activities are there
sql: SELECT countIf(a.sentiment = 'positive') AS jumlah_positif, countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') AS jumlah_negatif FROM activities AS a

question: Show the number of tickets that are still open and the total number of all tickets.
sql: SELECT countIf(t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) AS tiket_terbuka, count() AS total_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL

question: total value of won deals and total value of lost deals
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS nilai_won, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'lost') AS nilai_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: per activity type, what percent have positive sentiment
sql: SELECT a.type, round(countIf(a.sentiment = 'positive') / count(), 2) AS rasio_positif FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type

question: revenue and pipeline value per team
sql: SELECT r.team, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset, sumIf(d.value, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS nilai_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: Compare the average duration of meetings and demos.
sql: SELECT round(avgIf(a.duration_minutes, a.type = 'meeting'), 2) AS avg_meeting, round(avgIf(a.duration_minutes, a.type = 'demo'), 2) AS avg_demo FROM activities AS a

question: for each ticket priority: how many are unresolved and how many are done (resolved/closed)
sql: SELECT t.priority, countIf(t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) AS tiket_belum_selesai, countIf(t.status IN ('resolved','closed')) AS tiket_selesai FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority

question: summary of won vs lost deals per month, last year
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan

question: Which sales reps have a win rate above 0.4?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) > 0.4

question: which Enterprise customers have at least 2 urgent tickets? include the count
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') AS jumlah_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') >= 2

question: per sales rep, compare this year's revenue (YTD) with revenue for the same period last year
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS omset_ytd, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < subtractYears(now(), 1)) AS omset_ytd_tahun_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name

question: per sales region: ratio of positive activities and average call duration
sql: SELECT r.region, round(countIf(a.sentiment = 'positive') / count(), 2) AS rasio_positif, round(avgIf(a.duration_minutes, a.type = 'call'), 2) AS avg_durasi_call FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.region

question: Show won deals above 400,000 along with the customer name.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, c.name AS customer_name FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.value > 400000

question: list urgent tickets belonging to Enterprise customers
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise'

question: Find customers who have an open high-priority ticket
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN support_tickets AS t FINAL ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id WHERE t.priority = 'high' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress')

question: Summary of the number of activities for each sales rep last month
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND a.timestamp < toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name

question: average meeting duration per customer segment please
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.type = 'meeting' GROUP BY c.segment

question: What is the average ticket resolution time for each customer segment?
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_waktu_selesai FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: which customers have total won deals of more than 1 million
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING sum(d.value) > 1000000

question: pipeline value per customer region
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS customer_region, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY c.attributes['region']

question: forecast for each sales team (weighted pipeline)
sql: SELECT r.team, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS weighted_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY r.team

question: Enterprise customer revenue per quarter for last year
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY kuartal ORDER BY kuartal

question: per sales rep, compare the number of won vs lost deals
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name

question: What is the average won deal value per customer industry? Show only industries with an average above 100,000.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industry, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.attributes['industry'] HAVING avg(d.value) > 100000

question: churned customers who still have open deals
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'churned' AND d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')

question: deal title, company, and sales rep name for deals currently in negotiation
sql: SELECT d.title, c.company, r.name AS rep_name FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'negotiation'

question: What is the total revenue from Enterprise customers handled by sales reps in the APAC region?
sql: SELECT sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND r.region = 'APAC'

question: number of open deals of SMB customers handled by the Outbound-Enterprise team
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND c.segment = 'SMB' AND r.team = 'Outbound-Enterprise'

question: how many demos were given to active customers by EMEA sales reps
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_demo FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'demo' AND c.status = 'active' AND r.region = 'EMEA'

question: List activities with negative sentiment toward Enterprise customers handled by the Inbound team
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.sentiment = 'negative' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND r.team = 'Inbound'

question: total revenue from Gold-tier customers through sales reps in the NA region
sql: SELECT sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold' AND r.region = 'NA'

question: revenue of each sales rep per customer segment
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, c.segment, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, c.segment

question: Summary of the number of won deals per sales team and region
sql: SELECT r.team, r.region, count() AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team, r.region

question: who are the top 5 sales reps by revenue from Enterprise customers this year
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many distinct active customers did each sales rep contact in the last 90 days?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, uniqExact(c.customer_id) AS jumlah_customer FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE c.status = 'active' AND a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 90) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name

question: average activity duration per sales team and customer segment
sql: SELECT r.team, c.segment, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team, c.segment

question: revenue per customer region and sales region
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS customer_region, r.region AS rep_region, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.attributes['region'], r.region

question: monthly revenue for the last 12 months from Enterprise customers handled by the Account-Management team
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND r.team = 'Account-Management' AND d.closed_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 12) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Show lost deals above 300,000 with the company and sales rep name, sorted by value from largest to smallest.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, c.company, r.name AS rep_name FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'lost' AND d.value > 300000 ORDER BY d.value DESC

question: average won deal value per customer industry and sales team
sql: SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industry, r.team, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.attributes['industry'], r.team

question: revenue per product from Enterprise customers handled by APAC sales reps
sql: SELECT product, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND r.region = 'APAC' GROUP BY product

question: For each Enterprise customer, show total revenue and number of tickets.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, dl.total_omset, tk.jumlah_tiket FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS dl ON c.customer_id = dl.customer_id INNER JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS tk ON c.customer_id = tk.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise'

question: per sales rep: revenue this year and number of activities this year
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, dl.total_omset, ac.jumlah_aktivitas FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS dl ON r.rep_id = dl.rep_id INNER JOIN (SELECT a.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY a.rep_id) AS ac ON r.rep_id = ac.rep_id

question: Find active customers who have a won deal but have never created a support ticket
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN deals AS d FINAL ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id LEFT JOIN support_tickets AS t FINAL ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'active' AND d.stage = 'won' AND t.ticket_id = ''

question: win rate of each sales rep for Enterprise customers, only those with at least 10 closed deals
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) >= 10

question: which sales reps handle churned Enterprise customers with total lost deal value of more than 1 million?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS total_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'lost' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND c.status = 'churned' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING sum(d.value) > 1000000

question: Compare YTD revenue with the same period last year for each sales team, Enterprise customers only
sql: SELECT r.team, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS omset_ytd, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < subtractYears(now(), 1)) AS omset_ytd_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY r.team

question: number of activities per quarter last year for each sales team, SMB customers only
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(a.timestamp) AS kuartal, r.team, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE c.segment = 'SMB' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND a.timestamp < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY kuartal, r.team ORDER BY kuartal, r.team

question: how many deals involve the API-Gateway product?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE has(d.products_involved, 'API-Gateway')

question: Show customers from the APAC region
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['region'] = 'APAC'

question: find active Gold-tier Enterprise-segment customers, just the name and email
sql: SELECT c.name, c.email FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise'

question: Show open deals that include Security-Plus or Analytics-Suite
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND hasAny(d.products_involved, ['Security-Plus','Analytics-Suite'])

question: number of customers for each tag
sql: SELECT tag, count() AS jumlah_customer FROM customers AS c FINAL ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag GROUP BY tag

question: average number of products per won deal
sql: SELECT round(avg(length(d.products_involved)), 2) AS rata_produk FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: Finance industry customers that have both the high-value and strategic tags
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['industry'] = 'Finance' AND has(c.tags, 'high-value') AND has(c.tags, 'strategic')

question: summary of the number of customers per industry
sql: SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industry, count() AS jumlah_customer FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.attributes['industry']

question: 10 won deals with at least 3 products, largest value first
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND length(d.products_involved) >= 3 ORDER BY d.value DESC LIMIT 10

question: Calculate revenue per product for this year
sql: SELECT product, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY product

question: customers tagged finance whose industry is not Finance
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE has(c.tags, 'finance') AND c.attributes['industry'] != 'Finance'

question: number of active customers per region and tier combination
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS customer_region, c.attributes['tier'] AS customer_tier, count() AS jumlah_customer FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active' GROUP BY c.attributes['region'], c.attributes['tier']

question: revenue per customer tag throughout last year
sql: SELECT tag, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY tag

question: How many tickets came in yesterday?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE toDate(t.created_at) = yesterday()

question: new customers in the last 30 days, list them please
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= subtractDays(now(), 30)

question: Summary of revenue per month throughout this year.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan

question: how's the average call duration per week over the last 8 weeks?
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(a.timestamp, 1) AS minggu, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_durasi FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'call' AND a.timestamp >= subtractWeeks(now(), 8) GROUP BY minggu

question: Urgent tickets per day over the last 7 days
sql: SELECT toDate(t.created_at) AS hari, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.created_at >= subtractDays(now(), 7) GROUP BY hari

question: Compare revenue this quarter with last quarter, show both figures.
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today())) AS omset_kuartal_ini, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfQuarter(today())) AS omset_kuartal_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1))

question: On average, how many days from deal creation to won, for deals won this year?
sql: SELECT round(avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date)), 2) AS rata_hari_closing FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())

question: number of new customers each quarter last year
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(c.created_at) AS kuartal, count() AS jumlah_customer FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND c.created_at < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY kuartal

question: Which day of the week is busiest for demo activities?
sql: SELECT toDayOfWeek(a.timestamp) AS hari_ke, count() AS jumlah_demo FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo' GROUP BY hari_ke ORDER BY jumlah_demo DESC LIMIT 1

question: YTD revenue this year versus the same period last year, please show both.
sql: SELECT sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS omset_ytd, sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < subtractYears(now(), 1)) AS omset_ytd_tahun_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1))

question: per month over the last 6 months, how many won deals and how many lost deals?
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND d.closed_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 6) GROUP BY bulan

question: Who are the 5 sales reps with the fastest average closing time (in days) for won deals last year?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(avg(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date)), 2) AS rata_hari_closing FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY rata_hari_closing ASC LIMIT 5

question: Weekly ticket summary for last month: number of tickets and average resolution time in hours.
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_tiket, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_jam_selesai FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND t.created_at < toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY minggu

question: Count pipeline deals that were created more than 90 days ago, per sales rep.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_deal_lama FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND dateDiff('day', d.created_date, now()) > 90 GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name

question: summary per sales team: number of won deals and total revenue this quarter
sql: SELECT r.team, count() AS jumlah_won, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today()) GROUP BY r.team

question: Rank sales reps by total revenue this year.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name

question: give a sequence number to won deals above 400,000, from the largest value
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS nomor_urut FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.value > 400000

question: Rank segments by number of customers
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_customer, rank() OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment

question: Rank products by revenue please
sql: SELECT product, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY product

question: Show cumulative revenue (running total) per month this year.
sql: SELECT m.bulan, m.omset_bulanan, sum(m.omset_bulanan) OVER (ORDER BY m.bulan) AS omset_kumulatif FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset_bulanan FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan) AS m

question: top 3 largest won deals for each sales rep, along with the sales rep's name
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.rep_name FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, r.name AS rep_name, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.rep_id ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x WHERE x.rn <= 3

question: Rank of sales reps within their own team by revenue
sql: SELECT r.team, r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name

question: Sort Enterprise customers by their total won deal value, with a rank.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name

question: cumulative number of tickets per month throughout last year
sql: SELECT m.bulan, m.jumlah_tiket, sum(m.jumlah_tiket) OVER (ORDER BY m.bulan) AS tiket_kumulatif FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND t.created_at < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan) AS m

question: Which sales reps are in last month's demo ranking? Show the number of demos and the rank.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_demo, rank() OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'demo' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND a.timestamp < toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name

question: Difference in revenue of each month versus the previous month during last year, no need to show the first month.
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.omset_bulanan, x.omset_bulanan - x.omset_sebelumnya AS selisih_omset FROM (SELECT m.bulan AS bulan, m.omset_bulanan AS omset_bulanan, lagInFrame(m.omset_bulanan, 1) OVER (ORDER BY m.bulan) AS omset_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY m.bulan) AS rn FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset_bulanan FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan) AS m) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1

question: calculate the 3-month moving average of revenue (that month and the 2 previous months) for last year
sql: SELECT m.bulan, m.omset_bulanan, round(avg(m.omset_bulanan) OVER (ORDER BY m.bulan ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rata_bergerak_3_bulan FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset_bulanan FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan) AS m

question: Show the top 2 customers by revenue in each segment, along with their revenue.
sql: SELECT x.segment, x.customer_id, x.name, x.total_omset FROM (SELECT c.segment AS segment, c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment, c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 2

question: What is each sales rep's contribution ratio to the company's total revenue?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, round(sum(d.value) / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (), 2) AS rasio_kontribusi FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name

question: For each won deal, how many days since the same customer's previous won deal? Skip each customer's first won deal.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.customer_id, x.jarak_hari FROM (SELECT d.deal_id AS deal_id, d.customer_id AS customer_id, dateDiff('day', lagInFrame(d.closed_date, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.closed_date), d.closed_date) AS jarak_hari, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x WHERE x.rn > 1

question: The most recent won deal for each Enterprise customer, one per customer, with the customer's name.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.customer_name FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, c.name AS customer_name, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY d.closed_date DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Show deals whose value is above the average value of all deals.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.value > (SELECT avg(d2.value) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL)

question: customers who've had a demo, list them
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo')

question: List sales reps who have closed a won deal above 450,000.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.rep_id IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.value > 450000)

question: customers who currently have a deal in the pipeline
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation'))

question: Which customers have total revenue above the average revenue per customer?
sql: WITH omset_pelanggan AS (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, o.total_omset FROM omset_pelanggan AS o INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.total_omset > (SELECT avg(x.total_omset) FROM omset_pelanggan AS x)

question: Show customers who have more than 2 open tickets.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') GROUP BY t.customer_id HAVING count() > 2)

question: which sales reps have an average won deal value higher than the company-wide average won deal value?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING avg(d.value) > (SELECT avg(d2.value) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won')

question: Won deals this year that came from customers with churned status
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned')

question: negative activities from Enterprise customers in the APAC region
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp FROM activities AS a WHERE a.sentiment = 'negative' AND a.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND c.attributes['region'] = 'APAC')

question: How many unique customers have a won deal and have also created a high or urgent priority ticket?
sql: SELECT uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority IN ('high','urgent'))

question: Find active customers with no activity at all in the last 30 days.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30))

question: Which segments have revenue above the average revenue across segments?
sql: WITH omset_segmen AS (SELECT c.segment AS segment, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment) SELECT s.segment, s.total_omset FROM omset_segmen AS s WHERE s.total_omset > (SELECT avg(x.total_omset) FROM omset_segmen AS x)

question: Which sales reps have more lost deals than the average number of lost deals per sales rep?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'lost' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING count() > (SELECT avg(l.jumlah_lost) FROM (SELECT count() AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'lost' GROUP BY d2.rep_id) AS l)

question: Find customers who have a won deal but have never created any ticket.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL)

question: Show the top 5 customers by revenue along with the number of tickets they have created.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, o.total_omset, tk.jumlah_tiket FROM (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 5) AS o INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS tk ON o.customer_id = tk.customer_id ORDER BY o.total_omset DESC

question: Won deals whose value is greater than the average won deal value of the same sales rep
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d2.rep_id AS rep_id, avg(d2.value) AS rata_nilai FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d2.rep_id) AS rep_avg ON d.rep_id = rep_avg.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.value > rep_avg.rata_nilai

question: Which sales reps have a win rate higher than the company's overall win rate? Show the win rate.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) > (SELECT countIf(d2.stage = 'won') / countIf(d2.stage IN ('won','lost')) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL)
